children: Piper Sandler reiterated their Overweight rating on Mid Penn Bancorp's stock with a price target of $40.00.
The price target implies an upside of 16.3% from the Oct 26 close of $34.41.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Mid Penn Bancorp demonstrated robust deposit growth of 10% on a last quarter annualized (LQA) basis, indicating solid customer confidence and a strong cash management deposit pipeline that supports medium-term growth prospects.

: Despite a recent decline in shares, Mid Penn Bancorp's stock trades at a lower valuation (9.2x '27E) compared to its peers (10.5x), suggesting that the market has undervalued the company relative to its above-peer return profile, warranting an Overweight rating.
